routing.prompt: Audit this repository for how well coding agents can verify their own changes without me acting as the test suite.
I'm starting a new TypeScript service. Set it up so agents can check their own work: fast tests, type checks, and clear instructions.
A new model just came out. Re-audit our instruction files, skills, and review gates for what it now gets wrong or no longer needs.
Review this diff for correctness bugs before I merge it.
Check the onboarding flow in the running app before it ships: states, copy, and keyboard access.

rules.task: You finished a read-only agent-readiness audit of a web app repository.
